How do you determine the pallet capacity of a refrigerated trailer?

A common reference for a refrigerated semi-trailer is 33 Euro pallet positions on the floor. Actual capacity varies with specification and loading. Pallet dimensions, overhang, weight, stackability and required airflow determine how much can be carried. Have the available capacity confirmed for your specific shipment; a number of pallet positions does not guarantee payload capacity.

OKT Logistics BV · Transport knowledge

Use actual dimensions

Provide the length, width and height of the loaded pallet. Overhanging goods or non-standard pallet dimensions may change the layout.

Weight and distribution

Cargo weight matters alongside available floor space. Uneven distribution may also affect loading. Have the carrier assess the specific load.

Space for product conditions

Agreed loading requirements must be followed for temperature-sensitive goods. Do not fill the trailer based on a theoretical count if this conflicts with product or equipment instructions.

Pallet positions and payload

For the S.KO COOL the manufacturer lists, among other specifications, 33 Euro pallet positions depending on the version. This is a general equipment reference. Operations will confirm available capacity and suitable loading for your enquiry.

FTL or groupage: which fits your chilled shipment?

FTL means booking a full truckload; groupage combines compatible smaller shipments. Suitability depends on volume, weight, route, temperature and time windows. Groupage is not possible for every shipment. Discuss product conditions, collection and delivery arrangements and any special requirements alongside the pallet count.

OKT Logistics BV · Transport knowledge

When FTL fits

A full load or the need for a dedicated journey may be reasons to discuss FTL. Tight time windows or specific goods requirements can also make combining loads less suitable.

When groupage fits

Smaller shipments can sometimes share a journey. This requires compatible routes, product conditions, capacity and collection and delivery times.

Price is not just per pallet

Distance, time windows, temperature, weight and space requirements affect the quote. Groupage is not automatically the cheapest or fastest option for every shipment.

Compare using the same details

Send the same product and route details for both options. Indicate where there is flexibility. Operations can then assess suitable options on a comparable basis.

Coordination at handover

The condition of goods at loading, packaging and handover duration may matter. Describe special loading and unloading instructions and designate a contact person.

Discuss required documentation before placing the order. If the product specification is unclear, clarification is needed.

Preparing flowers and plants for transport

Temperature based on your product specification

Packaging, loading and protection

Specify boxes, pallets or trolleys, including overall dimensions, height, weight and stackability. Describe fragile parts and securing requirements. For trolleys or returnable equipment, compatibility with the available vehicle and return arrangements must be agreed in advance.

Collection and receiving windows

Send complete addresses, contact people and requested loading and unloading times. Include booking procedures, location numbers and receiving appointments. Report changes promptly so planning can be reviewed. State who the driver should contact on arrival.

Flower transport in the Netherlands and across borders

OKT Logistics BV is based in Escharen, North Brabant. We assess transport enquiries within the Netherlands and on routes to Germany, Belgium and France. For international flower transport, provide exact addresses, receiving windows and consignee contact details. A country or region alone is not enough to assess availability or price.
